title: NavySimulator Critical Parts
description: Parts of common/units/critical_parts that critical hits can damage (S-CRIT-PART), written by 'NavySimulator import-ship-data'. Keys left out take the game's defaults.

strDamageMultiplier.description: Replaces the critical multiplier on the hit's HP damage (default 1).

orgDamageMultiplier.description: Replaces the critical multiplier on the hit's organization damage (default 1).

strDamage.description: HP damage added to the hit (default 0).

orgDamage.description: Organization damage added to the hit (default 0).

baseDamageInstance.description: Times it can be damaged once a sub-unit or module brings it; -1 any (default 1).

damageInstancePerAddedModule.description: More times for each further module with it (default 0).

statPenalties.description: Factor penalties: stat x max(0, 1 + count x penalty) (S-STATS-PARTS).

modifiers.description: Modifiers by game key, x count x (1 + naval_critical_effect_factor).
